name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Technical Product Owner
summary: Technical Product Owner with 25+ years bridging business strategy and engineering execution. Proven expertise in Agile product delivery, stakeholder buy-in, and large-scale backlog management. Track record of leading cross-functional teams, defining product roadmaps, and delivering customer-centric solutions through data-driven decision making and collaborative leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Manager
details: Product Ownership & Strategy
• Partnered closely with Product Owner and Scrum Master to define and execute product roadmap, balancing strategic objectives with urgent business needs and maintaining delivery commitments
• Led successful modernization of legacy in-production application, launching first clients live in under 9 months through iterative delivery approach and continuous stakeholder engagement
• Defined and prioritized product and technical debt backlog items, ensuring alignment with business value, roadmap milestones, and industry compliance standards
• Established comprehensive release management process using MS Planner, OneNote, Jira, and Confluence, improving release qualification consistency and reducing reactive issue resolution
Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery
• Managed competing priorities across stakeholder groups, successfully delivered consistent sprint commitments while maintaining quality standards
• Established team working agreements and Scrum delivery practices, improving team velocity and predictability in resource-constrained environment
• Facilitated backlog refinement and sprint planning sessions, translating business requirements into actionable user stories and technical tasks
• Communicated product vision and technical trade-offs to business stakeholders, securing buy-in for modernization initiatives
Technical Leadership & Team Development
• Enhanced API-driven product design by deconstructing monolithic schemas into atomic units, improving system flexibility and compliance reporting using Redocly
• Led migration from BitBucket to GitHub, establishing modern CI/CD pipelines and improving deployment reliability across two mission-critical APIs
• Mentored and onboarded team members across all experience levels, conducting code reviews and establishing quality standards
• Partnered with enterprise team to establish Behavior-Driven-Design test framework using Cucumber, improving test coverage and documentation
• Designed operational sequences and system flows using C4 templates in Mermaid, enhancing team understanding and onboarding efficiency
